critique: The core beat of the brief never happens: all four trim-path draw-ons fail to render, so the wheat and loaf sit fully drawn from frame 0. Georgia also falls back to a generic sans, so the title loses its friendly serif warmth and the hand-drawn reveal reads as static clip-art with blobs fading behind it.

Make the stroke reveal actually render (trim on a supported shape/stroke, or a masked or animated-dash reveal). Swap the boil from whole-layer position jitter to per-12fps path-vertex offsets or alternating path keys so the lines truly wobble. Then load a real rounded or hand-lettered face for 'Crumb & Co'.
